sql: WITH RECURSIVE p(n) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM p WHERE n<20),f AS (SELECT id_bioguide,min(term_start) first FROM legislators_terms GROUP BY id_bioguide HAVING min(term_start) BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'),c AS (SELECT f.*,n,cast(substr(first,1,4) as int)+n y FROM f CROSS JOIN p) SELECT n,count(*) denominator,sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t WHERE t.id_bioguide=c.id_bioguide AND y BETWEEN cast(substr(term_start,1,4) as int) AND cast(substr(term_end,1,4) as int))) any_service_in_year,sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t WHERE t.id_bioguide=c.id_bioguide AND date(c.first,'+'||n||' years') BETWEEN t.term_start AND t.term_end)) anniversary,sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t WHERE t.id_bioguide=c.id_bioguide AND date(t.term_start,'start of year')<=printf('%04d-12-31',y) AND printf('%04d-12-31',y)<=date(t.term_end,'start of year','+1 year','-1 day'))) annual_expanded FROM c GROUP BY n ORDER BY n
